zh-CN.title: 媒体预览操作优化
items: 上滑时照片随信息面板展开自动调整尺寸，长内容可以继续上滑查看，向下拉可收起信息。
打开信息后也能横滑切换照片及其详情。视频在沉浸模式下隐藏进度条。

en.title: Media viewer refinements
items: Photos resize as you reveal their details. Swipe up further to read longer details, or pull down to collapse them.
Swipe sideways to browse photos and their details. Video hides the seek bar in immersive mode.
